/-! ## The nonnegative Weil cone -/

/-- **The multiples-of-a-prime law of the nonnegative Weil cone.** If `lam ≥ 0` is full-cone
Weil-positive, then for every prime `p` the sums `Σ_{n≤k, p∣n} (lam(n) − Λ(n))/n` tend neither to
`+∞` nor to `−∞`. No size condition is placed on `lam`. -/

theorem weilFullFunctional_weilTest_eq_atomic {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hsl : ∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → Summable fun n : ℕ => |lam n| / (n : ℝ) ^ σ)
    {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] {c τ : ι → ℝ} (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hΦ : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re →
      HasSum (fun i => (c i : ℂ) * gPair (1 / 2 + τ i * I) s) (WeilHerglotz.weilFunction lam s))
    {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hfc : HasCompactSupport f) :
    HasSum (fun i => ((c i * (‖paperFT f (τ i)‖ ^ 2 + ‖paperFT f (-τ i)‖ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (weilFullFunctional lam (EF.weilTest f f))
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem weilFullFunctional_weilTest_eq_atomic {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hsl : ∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → Summable fun n : ℕ => |lam n| / (n : ℝ) ^ σ)
    {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] {c τ : ι → ℝ} (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hΦ : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re →
      HasSum (fun i => (c i : ℂ) * gPair (1 / 2 + τ i * I) s) (WeilHerglotz.weilFunction lam s))
    {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hfc : HasCompactSupport f) :
    HasSum (fun i => ((c i * (‖paperFT f (τ i)‖ ^ 2 + ‖paperFT f (-τ i)‖ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (weilFullFunctional lam (EF.weilTest f f))
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  obtain ⟨D, -, hD⟩ := norm_Hfn_weilTest_le hf hfc
  have h := hasSum_weilFullFunctional_atomic hsl hc hΦ
    (EF.weilTest_contDiff hf hf.continuous hfc) (EF.weilTest_hasCompactSupport hfc hfc) hD
  refine h.congr_fun fun i => ?_
  have hneg := paperFT_weilTest_self_ofReal hf.continuous hfc (-τ i)
  rw [Complex.ofReal_neg] at hneg
  rw [paperFT_weilTest_self_ofReal hf.continuous hfc, hneg]

        (xiRectangularTwoEdgeTransform L a)‖ ≤
      rectangularTwoEdgeRemainderBound L *
        ∑' q : XiZeroCopy, 1 / ‖xiSpectralPoint q‖ ^ 2
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hdom : (∑' q : XiZeroCopy,
      xiRectangularTwoEdgeDominant L a (xiSpectralPoint q)) = 0 := by
    have hzero : ∀ q : XiZeroCopy,
        xiRectangularTwoEdgeDominant L a (xiSpectralPoint q) = 0 := by
      intro q
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := xiSpectralPoint_real_of_rh hRH q

  exact hrem
